list.title: module:App
list.description: Root application component for SICODETRI-FRONT. Provides global context for fixed assets, mounts the routing layer, and wraps the UI with an error boundary and cross-context token bridge. Path: src/App.js

list.title: module:App~App
list.description:
Root React component of the application.

Responsibilities:

  • Initializes and provides {@link FixedAssetContext} with a default value.
  • Bridges authentication/authorization tokens across app layers via {@link TokenBridge}.
  • Renders the application router {@link GlobalRouter}.
  • Displays a global {@link Footer}.
  • Guards the entire tree with {@link ErrorBoundary} to catch render-time errors.

list.title: module:App~FixedAsset
list.description: A fixed asset item. Extend this shape as needed in the project (e.g., id, accountCode, amounts).

list.title: module:App~FixedAssetContextValue
list.description: Value provided through {@link FixedAssetContext}.

list.title: module:CallbackPage
list.description:
Callback page for handling OAuth2 PKCE login responses in SICODETRI-FRONT.
Evaluates the code parameter returned by the authorization server, checks authentication state, and redirects accordingly. Displays intermediate or error messages during the login flow.
Path: src/views/CallbackPage.jsx

list.title: module:CallbackPage~CallbackPage
list.description:
CallbackPage component.
Handles the redirect URI after OAuth2 PKCE login attempt.

Logic:

  • Extracts the code parameter from the query string using {@link useLocation}.
  • If no code is present and user is not authenticated, redirects to /.
  • If an authentication error exists, shows the error message.
  • If authenticated, redirects to /.
  • Otherwise, shows a "Processing callback..." message while login completes.

list.description:

Provides a wrapped {@link DatePicker} with customized headers, localized months, and controlled formats for year, month-year, or full date selection.
Path: src/components/CustomDatePicker.js

list.title: module:CustomDatePicker~CustomDatePicker
list.description:
CustomDatePicker component.

  • Displays a date picker with configurable formats (yyyy, yyyy-MM, yyyy-MM-dd).
  • Provides a custom header with year/month selectors and navigation buttons.
  • Localizes months to Spanish.
  • Disables manual keyboard input to ensure controlled selection.

list.title: module:CustomDatePicker~CustomDatePickerProps
list.description: Props for {@link CustomDatePicker}.

list.title: module:ErrorBoundary
list.description:
Error boundary component for SICODETRI-FRONT.
Provides a wrapper that catches JavaScript errors in child components and displays a fallback UI instead of breaking the entire application.
Implements React lifecycle methods {@link getDerivedStateFromError} and {@link componentDidCatch} to handle errors gracefully.
Path: src/components/ErrorBoundary.jsx

list.title: module:ErrorBoundary#componentDidCatch
list.description: Lifecycle method for logging or reporting errors.

list.title: module:ErrorBoundary#render
list.description: Renders the fallback UI when an error is caught, otherwise renders the children components.

list.title: module:ErrorBoundary.getDerivedStateFromError
list.description: Lifecycle method that updates state after an error is thrown in a child component.

list.title: module:ErrorPage
list.description:
Error page component for SICODETRI-FRONT.
Displays error details passed through query parameters (status, path, message) and provides navigation options for the user to retry or return to the home page.
Path: src/views/ErrorPage.jsx

list.title: module:ErrorPage~ErrorPage
list.description:
ErrorPage component.

  • Reads query parameters (status, path, message) via {@link useQuery}.
  • Displays an error message, status code, and affected path if available.
  • Provides navigation options to go back to home (/) or retry by reloading the page.

list.title: module:ErrorPage~useQuery
list.description:
Custom hook to parse query string parameters from the current location.
Uses {@link useLocation} to extract the search string and returns a URLSearchParams instance.

list.title: module:FileUpload
list.description:
File upload page for SICODETRI-FRONT.
Allows users to upload Excel files of financial fixed assets, select a period, and persist the data into the backend system. Displays progress, validation alerts, and success/error messages.
Path: src/views/FileUpload.js

list.title: module:FileUpload~FileUpload
list.description:
FileUpload component.
Main responsibilities:

  • Select a period using {@link CustomDatePicker}.
  • Upload Excel files to backend via {@link FinancialFixedAssetService.uploadService}.
  • Save data after validation via {@link FinancialFixedAssetService.saveService}.
  • Show upload progress and validation/error messages to the user.

list.title: module:FileUpload~saveDataFile
list.description:
Saves the uploaded data for the selected period.

  • Validates that a period has been selected.
  • Sends request to backend via {@link FinancialFixedAssetService.saveService}.
  • Updates progress and feedback messages.

list.title: module:FileUpload~selectFile
list.description: Handles file selection from the file input.

list.title: module:FileUpload~uploadFile
list.description:
Uploads the selected Excel file to the backend service.

  • Validates that a period has been selected.
  • Updates progress and feedback messages.
  • Handles both success and error responses.

list.title: module:GlobalRouter
list.description:
Global router configuration for SICODETRI-FRONT.
Defines application routes, integrates authentication checks via {@link PrivateRoute}, and mounts top-level navigation through {@link NavBar}.
Path: src/router/GlobalRouter.js

list.title: module:GlobalRouter~AppRouter
list.description:
AppRouter component.

  • Wraps the application inside {@link BrowserRouter}.
  • Renders {@link NavBar} globally.
  • Defines secure and public routes:
    • /callback: OAuth2 callback page.
    • /error: Error handler page.
    • /: Home (protected by {@link PrivateRoute}).
    • /upload: File upload (protected).
    • /temporary-deduction: Temporary deductions (protected).
    • /temporary-addition: Temporary additions (protected).
    • /permanent-addition: Permanent additions (protected).
    • /report-tax-book: Tax book report (protected).
    • /report-detail-depreciation: Detailed depreciation report (protected).
    • *: Any unknown path redirects to /.
  • Shows a loading state if authentication is still pending.

list.title: module:Home~parseJwt

PrivateRoute component for SICODETRI-FRONT.

Behavior:

  • If user is authenticated, renders the protected child components.

list.title: module:PrivateRoute
list.description:
Restricts access to authenticated users only.
If authentication is in progress, shows a loading indicator.
If not authenticated, triggers login process.

list.title: module:TokenBridge
list.description:
TokenBridge component for SICODETRI-FRONT.
Responsible for synchronizing the authentication token with sessionStorage.

Behavior:

  • Obtains authentication state and token from {@link useAuth}.
  • If the user is authenticated and a token is available, stores it in `sessionStorage` with the key pkce_token.
  • If not authenticated, ensures the key pkce_token is removed from `sessionStorage`.
  • Does not render any UI element; this component is purely functional.
Path: src/components/TokenBridge.jsx

Component: {@link TokenBridge}
Company: EPS Grau
Copyright: © 2024 EPS Grau.

list.title: module:TokenBridge
list.description:
Functional component that bridges authentication state with browser session storage.
Ensures that the OAuth2 PKCE token is persisted in sessionStorage when authenticated, and removed when authentication state is lost.

list.title: module:http-common
list.description:
HTTP common configuration module for API requests using Axios.
Provides a centralized Axios instance with interceptors for authentication and error handling across the SICODETRI-FRONT application.
Path: src/http-common.js

list.title: module:http-common~http
list.description:
Preconfigured Axios HTTP client instance.

  • Uses the base URL from environment variable REACT_APP_BASE_PATH_BACK.
  • Sends JSON content by default.
  • Includes credentials (cookies) in requests.
  • Attaches Authorization Bearer token from sessionStorage.pkce_token if present.
  • Handles global error responses (401, 403, 404, 500) with redirects to /error.

list.title: module:http-common~setAuthContextRef
list.description: Sets the authentication context reference.

list.title: module:index~WithAuthBridge
list.description:
Higher-order component that wraps {@link App} with OAuth2 PKCE authentication.

  • Initializes the {@link AuthProvider} with the {@link authConfig}.

list.title: module:index~authConfig

Authentication configuration for OAuth2 PKCE flow.
Values are loaded from environment variables defined at build time.

list.title: module:reportWebVitals
list.description:
Web Vitals reporting helper for SICODETRI-FRONT.
Invokes the web-vitals library to measure and report key performance metrics: CLS, FID, FCP, LCP, and TTFB.
Path: src/reportWebVitals.js

list.title: module:reportWebVitals~WebVitalsHandler
list.description: Signature of the callback that receives each reported metric.

list.title: module:reportWebVitals~WebVitalsMetric
list.description:
Web Vitals metric object as reported by the web-vitals library. (Shape simplified for JSDoc; see library types for full details.)
Typical fields include: name, value, id, delta, entries, rating.

list.title: module:reportWebVitals~reportWebVitals
list.description:
Reports Core Web Vitals and other key metrics to the provided callback.
When a function is passed, this utility subscribes it to all supported metrics:

  • CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) via {@link getCLS}
  • FID (First Input Delay) via {@link getFID}
  • FCP (First Contentful Paint) via {@link getFCP}
  • LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) via {@link getLCP}
  • TTFB (Time To First Byte) via {@link getTTFB}
